name: morphing-search
title: Morphing Search
description: A frosted pill search bar that turns terms into filter chips. Focus it and a panel of recent searches and suggestions blooms out of the bar like a drop of goo; press Enter and the word you typed lifts out of the field, flashes lime and lands in the bar as a teal chip. Remove a chip and the word flies back into the recent list.
docs:
Docs, props and examples: https://tween-ui.vercel.app/component/morphing-search
GSAP plugins (CustomEase) are registered inside the component, so there is nothing to set up.
